World design

Rillmere Valley

Climate, lighting and weather

Temperate river terraces; warm sunrise, overcast midday and light river mist. Rain is cosmetic until explicitly enabled in fishing rules.

Factions

River Compact; Ashen Survey

Settlement and service placement

Hearthford hub at the river crossing: Mara merchant/quest giver, Tovin trainer, Ilyra bank clerk, Orun smith, Selka cook and Neris fishing contact. Shrine on the dry west bank.

Travel-time tests

Proposed 45–90 seconds between early objectives, 3–5 minutes hub-to-north-gate on foot and a 7–10 minute optional exploration circuit; time real capsule travel, not map distance alone.

Environmental hazards

Shallow ford transitions into a clearly marked deep channel. A broken footbridge has safe banks and a visible return route. No climbing dependency.

Quest arc and consequences

First Steps teaches identity and interaction; Road Supplies repairs a warning post; The Sluice Signal reveals old waterworks being disturbed by survey crews.

Landmarks and discovery

Splitstone Ford; Lantern Orchard; Old Sluice Intake

Enemy families

Mossfang prowlers (1–4); Reedback beetles (3–6); Survey deserters (6–9)

Ore distribution

CopperOre: common low slopes; RiverTin: uncommon exposed cuts

Tree distribution

AshLog: managed edge groves; WillowBranch: river terraces outside paths

Fish species pools

SilverDace: river pools; Brownfin: deep channel; GlassMinnow: uncommon shaded reeds

Music and ambience

Acoustic strings and restrained low winds; water, woodwork and distant birds. Commission/original or licensed stems, never bundled here.

3D art production requirements

Graybox landscape, ford/bridge, six small service buildings, ore/tree stand-ins, shoreline and water material. Needs separately sourced terrain, foliage, props, buildings and creature sprites.

Optimization and streaming

One modest graybox map initially; separate town/wilderness actor budgets. Add internal streaming only after measured memory and traversal tests. Zone gates connect separate processes.

Author dry clear arrival spawns outside trigger bounds. Validate compatible build/capacity/eligibility before issuing a ticket. Gate labels are not stable identity; use the listed IDs. The reciprocal pair is checked by the documentation validator.

Concrete production and test steps

  1. Create the map/definition according to the asset pages; only activate the first-phase portion now.
  2. Graybox services/roads/water with legal primitives and validate capsule/navigation before art replacement.
  3. Register stable site/gate/encounter/NPC/objective IDs through the existing schemas.
  4. Assign current-phase references in zone runtime and run two-client admission/travel tests.
  5. Enter every service from spawn without jumping or climbing.
  6. Two players mine OreSite_01 after deterministic selection; one depletes its generation.
  7. One client takes north gate; the other stays in Hearthford.
  8. Fish from both sides of ford; reject cast from deep swimming water.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
